state.seed_assertion: Continuity testing should only be performed when a circuit is de-energized and verified safe.

sentences.1: Continuity testing should only be performed when a circuit is de-energized and verified safe.
sentences.2: Use continuity only when the circuit is de-energized and verified safe.
sentences.3: Continuity testing should only be performed on de-energized circuits to avoid false positive results from the supply voltage.
sentences.4: This saves time and resources while keeping machines performing at their best.
sentences.5: Using continuity mode on a live circuit produces false positive 'good' results due to the supply voltage overwhelming the meter's test current.
sentences.6: Using continuity mode on a live circuit and getting a false 'good' result from the supply voltage.
